scope: Fail closed if any combat action granted by a retained PRE-CU profession family, or referenced by a current NPC combat table, can fall through to the post-NGE combat path instead of the authoritative PRE-CU combat override path.

findings: Publish 14.1 combat commands and NPC special attacks are skill- and action-authored; player level and post-NGE profession packages are not their gameplay authority.

The current server routes PRE-CU attack rows through precu_combat_overrides.tab, whose values feed the restored HAM cost, weapon cadence, primary hit, secondary defense, state, and pool-damage handling.

Center of Being is the only retained profession command that intersects combat_data.tab without an override row; its authenticated lifecycle is intentionally a direct NON_ATTACK handler with a 50-point Action drain and a visible PRE-CU buff.
